items.summary: Neither CVD nor HPHT is objectively better — depends on budget, stone size, color goals. CVD (Chemical Vapor Deposition): grows diamonds layer by layer in a low-pressure vacuum chamber, best for budget-friendly colorless stones under 2 carats, often higher clarity (VS-VVS) and lower prices, but may need post-growth treatment for tint. HPHT (High Pressure High Temperature): mimics deep Earth conditions, best for vivid fancy colors and top-grade D-color stones, pure untreated color, but can have tiny metallic inclusions.
